info.title: Eve Industrialist
info.description: Eve Industrialist API v1. Same-origin SPA auth via Sanctum session cookies: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie, then send the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on writes. Errors are {message, errors?, code}.

delete.summary: Delete the current account and revoke its ESI tokens. @status 204

get.summary: The login email of the signed-in admin

put.summary: Change the email and, optionally, the password of the signed-in admin

post.description:
One item name per line. Each type is priced from item exchange
contracts that contain only that type, across all regions. Nothing is
stored. `meta.freshness` describes the public contract snapshot (last
hourly import), not regional orders.
post.summary: Appraise a list of items from public contracts

get.description:
Assets of all the user's characters, from the cache the background
refresh fills. Top-level items are paginated; items inside ships and
containers are nested under `children`. `meta.last_updated` is when the
cache was last filled (ISO 8601, null if never).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring over type, custom name, location, character and owner type.

get.description:
The same assets as `GET /assets`, grouped by solar system and then
station, both sorted by name, with totals in `summary`. Not paginated.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring over type, custom name, location, character and owner type.

get.description:
Mineral, PI and other material stacks in your assets, summed per type
and grouped, with each type priced at the market and totals in ISK.
`meta.corporation_assets_warning` says why corporation assets are left
out, or is null when they are included.

Every ship hull in your assets, grouped by ship group (Frigate,
Cruiser, ...) and sorted by name, with totals.

Mutated modules in your assets, grouped by base type and ranked by roll
quality within each group. Each item lists the attributes that differ
from the base type. Slow on a cold cache: it asks ESI about every item.

post.description:
Queues a background refresh that respects upstream freshness for
refresh of personal and corporation assets. Answers 202 at once; the
current list stays readable until the refresh replaces it, and
`meta.last_updated` changes when it has.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring over type, custom name, location, character and owner type.

get.description:
The corporation assets grouped like `GET /assets/by-location`. Same
permission as `GET /corporation/assets`; the 403 message says which
check failed.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring over type, custom name, location, character and owner type.

get.description:
Published blueprints whose name contains `q`, by name, at most 20
(not paginated). Falls back to ESI search when the SDE has no match.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match on the name).

get.description: Materials, products and base time for one manufacturing run.

Every blueprint in a market group (and its children) from the
precomputed costs, with your runs, rig bonus, facility tax and system
cost index applied. Sorted by profit, paginated (50 per page, max
200). meta.effective_structure_me_bonus is the ME bonus applied.

post.description:
Every T1 blueprint in a market group (or legacy category) priced from
current market data with your settings. One of market_group_id or
category_id is required. Sorted by profit, paginated (50 per page,
max 200).

Every reaction formula with your runs, rig bonus, facility tax and
system cost index. Sorted by profit, paginated (50 per page, max
200). meta.effective_rig_bonus is the ME bonus applied.

Resolves each step's materials into child steps and tags each step
with its manufacturing or reaction blueprint. Returns 201.

get.description:
Newest change first, without steps. `location_ids` is the saved stock
location filter that progress should use.

post.description:
Each entry becomes a top-level step with its intermediate reactions as
children. Entries without a known reaction formula are skipped; 422 when
none is left. Returns 201.
post.summary: Create a reaction build program from reaction plan entries

post.description:
The source programs are left unchanged. 422 unless at least two of the
ids are your programs. Returns 201 with the merged program.
post.summary: Merge your own programs into a new program

get.description:
With its step tree. `meta.volumes` maps the type id of every material
in the tree to its packaged volume in m3. Someone else's program is 404.

patch.description:
Stores the ids in `settings.location_ids`; an empty or missing list
clears the filter.
patch.summary: Set the location filter of a build program

get.description:
How much of the program the user already holds, counting the assets of
all their characters (optionally only at some stations/structures).
Someone else's program is 404; a user with no linked characters gets 400.

Stations and structures where the user's characters hold items, by
solar system then name, for the progress location filter. Someone
else's program is 404.

Per character, and per corporation where the character is a director or
station manager: the blueprints they hold, cross-referenced with the
materials in their hangars, giving the runs and output each item allows.
Cached for an hour; `POST /industry/can-produce/refresh` recomputes it.

post.summary: Set one of your linked characters as main. @status 204

delete.summary: Remove a linked character, keeping at least one character. @status 204

get.description:
Contracts from the hourly import across all regions, newest first.
`meta.stats` counts every stored contract by type, ignoring the filters.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Contracts whose title contains this text.

get.description:
One contract with its item lines (type names resolved from the SDE).
404 when the contract is gone, e.g. after the next import.

True when your corporation has corporate build programs enabled and
one of your characters there is a Director, CEO or Factory Manager.
The calculator pages show their "corporate build program" buttons only
when it is.
get.summary: Whether the calculators may export to a corporate build program

get.description:
ESI corporation search run as the user's main character (or any of
their characters), at most 10 results (not paginated). Empty when the
user has no character or ESI returns nothing.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match on the name).

post.description:
Same input as a personal program; it belongs to your corporation.
Returns 201.

get.description:
Whether corporate build programs are enabled for the corporation of one
of your characters, by whom, what you may do with them and the
programs, newest change first. `programs` is empty unless you have a
character in that corporation (`can_view`). `eligible_characters` are
yours that could enable the feature (Director or CEO with the
corporation assets scope). Never 403, so the page can offer to enable
the feature.

post.description: 422 when none of the entries has a known reaction formula. Returns 201.
post.summary: Create a corporate reaction build program from reaction plan entries

post.description:
The source programs are left unchanged. 422 unless at least two of the
ids belong to your corporation. Returns 201 with the merged program.
post.summary: Merge your corporation's programs into a new program

get.description:
The program with its step tree and the volume (m3) of each material
type. A program of another corporation is 404, as is any when the
feature is not enabled for yours.

patch.summary: Set the location filters of a corporate build program

post.description:
Uses the given character's token for corporation asset lookups (or the
first eligible one). 422 when you have no eligible character or the
given one is not. Returns the new overview.

Only the user who enabled them may (403 otherwise). Existing programs
are kept. Returns the new overview.

get.description:
Materials are counted in the corporation assets at the input
locations, finished products at the output locations (all locations
when no filter is given). Assets are fetched with the enabling
director's token. A program of another corporation is 404.

Stations and structures that hold corporation assets, by solar system
then name, for the input/output location filters. Empty when the
director character is gone. A program of another corporation is 404.

User and character counts, new registrations and logins per day over
30 days, and the ten newest users. Admins only.

Industry job and slot counts and planetary alerts (read from caches that
`dashboard:refresh` warms every 15 minutes, computed on the spot when
cold), the user's characters with their last known location and training,
and their saved reaction and invention plans.

get.summary: Discord welcome bot settings. The token is never returned, only whether one is stored

get.description:
Player donations into the corporation wallets, grouped by donator and
sorted by total, largest first. Needs donation tracking enabled for the
corporation of one of the user's characters; otherwise 403.
`meta.summary` holds the range, the grand total and the wallet
divisions. Amounts are wallet ISK, not market prices, so there is no
`meta.freshness`.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: First day (Y-m-d). Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Last day (Y-m-d), inclusive. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: division
parameters.description: Corporation wallet division (1 = master wallet). Defaults to all.

get.description:
Whether donation tracking is enabled for the corporation of one of the
user's characters, who provides the wallet access, and which of the
user's characters could enable it (corporate wallet scope). Open to any
signed-in user, so the page can offer to enable tracking where
`GET /corporation/donations` answers 403.

post.description:
Uses the given character's corporate wallet access (or the first
eligible one). 422 when the user has no character with the
`esi-wallet.read_corporation_wallets.v1` scope or the given one is not
eligible. Returns the new status.

Only the user who enabled it may; anyone else gets 403. Returns the new
status.

Forgets the cached wallet journals of the corporation, so the next read
asks ESI again. Returns 204.

get.description:
Upstream requests, error percentage, 401/403/404 and upstream 420/429
counts, protection episodes and local deferrals for the range (default
last 24 hours, at most 31 days). Admins only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given. Default 24 hours before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range. Default now. The range may not exceed the configured maximum.

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Cursor for failure detail: only rows with a lower id. Use `meta.next_cursor`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Failure detail page size, default 50, at most 100.

get.description:
Error counts over time beside the lowest observed legacy remaining
budget, plus one series per token group. Admins only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given. Default 24 hours before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range. Default now. The range may not exceed the configured maximum.

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Cursor for failure detail: only rows with a lower id. Use `meta.next_cursor`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Failure detail page size, default 50, at most 100.

get.description:
By error count, with raw counts beside errors per 1,000 upstream
requests. Admins only.
get.summary: ESI diagnostics top endpoints and reasons

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given. Default 24 hours before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range. Default now. The range may not exceed the configured maximum.

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Cursor for failure detail: only rows with a lower id. Use `meta.next_cursor`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Failure detail page size, default 50, at most 100.

get.description:
Recent stored failures and circuit transitions, newest first, with
cursor pagination: pass `meta.next_cursor` as `before_id`. Admins only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given. Default 24 hours before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range. Default now. The range may not exceed the configured maximum.

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Cursor for failure detail: only rows with a lower id. Use `meta.next_cursor`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Failure detail page size, default 50, at most 100.

get.description:
Batch fingerprints seen more than once. A repeated fingerprint marks a
recurring batch, not which item in it is invalid. Admins only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given. Default 24 hours before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range. Default now. The range may not exceed the configured maximum.

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Cursor for failure detail: only rows with a lower id. Use `meta.next_cursor`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Failure detail page size, default 50, at most 100.

get.description:
Last ingestion, backlog, oldest event age, dropped events and gaps.
Admins only.

Systems the user's corporation tracks, by name, with the next payout
and the five latest recorded payouts. The corporation is the main
character's (or any character's when there is no main); without one,
403.

post.description:
Adds the system to the corporation's tracker, or changes its cycle when
it is tracked already. Returns 201.

put.description: Without a next payout time or anchor the current anchor stays.

post.description: Returns 201 with the system, its recent payouts including this one.

get.description:
Daily input cost, output value and profit per planet for every
schematic in a tier, after customs tax. The list is the tier's fixed
set of schematics, so it is not paginated.

Public readiness check used by the post-deploy smoke test: the
database answers and the cache can write and read. 200 when every
check is `ok`, 503 when any is `failed`. No authentication.

Manufacturing, research and reaction slots per character, with the
running jobs, and the jobs ready for collection (ending within a
minute). Slots are read from a cache that background jobs keep warm;
`meta.cached_until` is when the cache may next refresh. No prices are
involved, so there is no `meta.freshness`.

Items in the user's assets worth more reprocessed than sold, per
character and location, with totals. Prices are the global market
prices, so `meta.freshness` is The Forge's.

post.description:
Forgets the industry and ESI caches of all your characters. Allowed once
every 30 minutes; sooner it answers 429 and clears nothing.
Forgets the cached slot data of your characters and recomputes it now.

Forgets the cached blueprints, assets and roles of your characters and
corporations and recomputes what you can produce now.

Invention probability and cost (datacores, decryptor), the T2 BPC,
T2 materials with buildable components, job fees and the full-buy /
full-build scenarios. An item whose invention chain cannot be
resolved is a 422 on t2_type_id.
post.summary: Calculate an invention + T2 manufacturing chain

get.description:
Industry, Advanced Industry, encryption and datacore science skill
levels, plus every trained level by skill id. 404 when the character
is not one of yours.
get.summary: Invention skills of one of your characters

get.description:
The decryptors the invention calculator accepts as `decryptor_key`, with
their probability multiplier and ME, TE and run modifiers.

Published Tech II items with an invention chain whose name contains
`q`, by name, at most 20 (not paginated).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match on the name).

get.description: 404 when the item is not a Tech II item that can be invented.
get.summary: Invention chain for a T2 item

get.description: Sorted by name.

post.description:
Omitted settings fall back to defaults (no decryptor, no skills, one
run, no structure, highsec, 0 tax).

put.summary: Update an invention plan. Partial: only the fields sent change

get.description:
Active jobs across all the user's characters, grouped by activity, with
the manufacturing and reaction output totalled per item. Values use
the sell prices of the chosen trade hub, so `meta.freshness` is that
region's. Read from a cache that background jobs keep warm.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Trade hub whose sell prices value the output. Default 10000002 (The Forge / Jita).

post.description:
Materials (with buildable components at ME 10), build time, job fees
(EIV x system cost index + facility tax, when solar_system_id and/or
reaction_solar_system_id are given) and the full-buy / full-build
profit scenarios. Materials, base time and portion size come from the
SDE when not posted. A blueprint with no materials is a 422 on
blueprint_type_id.

Profit and margin per job and in total, from each job's revenue,
input cost and fees as returned by the calculate endpoint.

get.description:
Industry and Advanced Industry levels. 404 when the character is not
one of yours.
get.summary: Manufacturing skills of one of your characters

post.description:
Summed over your characters with the assets scope; one row per
requested type id (0 when none is owned).
post.summary: Owned quantity of each requested type

get.description:
Item categories that contain Tech I manufacturable products (invented
blueprints excluded), by name, with product counts. A small fixed SDE
list, so not paginated.

The same price the calculators use: the volume-weighted average of the
cheapest 5% of sell orders in the region (`source: orders`), else the
stored market_prices value (`fallback`), else 0 (`none`). Items come
back in request order, duplicates removed. Not paginated.
get.summary: Sell prices for up to 200 types

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Trade hub region. Default 10000002 (The Forge / Jita).

get.description:
The most recent `days` daily rows (default 30, max 365) from the
everef history import, newest first, paginated. 404 when the type is
unknown; an empty list when it has no history in the region.
get.summary: Daily market history for a type

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Trade hub region. Default 10000002 (The Forge / Jita).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of most recent daily rows, 1 to 365. Default 30.

get.description:
Open orders (volume remaining > 0) for one type in one trade hub
region, best first: sell orders cheapest first, buy orders highest
first. Paginated.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Trade hub region. Default 10000002 (The Forge / Jita).

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: sell (cheapest first) or buy (highest first). Default sell.

get.description:
Per trade region: when orders, precomputed manufacturing costs and ESI
global prices were last refreshed, and whether any of them is stale.
Orders are "as of" the start of the region's last complete order sweep.
Stale thresholds: orders 2 h, costs 5 h, global prices 26 h.
Top-level market groups by name. A small fixed SDE list, so not paginated.

Every market group that leads to a Tech I manufacturable item, nested,
without items.

The group, its breadcrumbs, child groups and the published items listed
in it. `exclude_meta_groups[]` leaves out meta groups.

The signed-in user with their linked characters (and granted ESI scopes)
and the `admin` / `stock_manager` feature flags.

put.description:
Moons are shared by corporation: the user's main character's corporation
(any character if there is no main) must own the scan system. Without a
corporation the answer is 422; a moon of another corporation is 404.
With `occupied` false the occupier is cleared.
put.summary: Set who occupies a scanned moon

post.description:
Parses the pasted scan, prices every moon and grades it, and stores the
result for the user's corporation (one stored system per system, one
stored moon per moon name, re-scans overwrite). Returns 201 when
moons were stored, 200 when the paste held no usable moon data (nothing
stored; see `data.errors`). Values come from market prices, so
`meta.freshness` is for the chosen region.

get.description:
Systems the user's corporation has scanned, by name. Empty when the
user has no character.

The stored moons of one system of the user's corporation, best first.
`pricing_mode` re-prices them on the fly. A user without a character
gets 422; a system the corporation has not scanned is 404. Values come
from market prices, so `meta.freshness` is for the scan's region.

parameters.name: pricing_mode
parameters.description: Re-price the stored moons in this mode instead of the stored one.

get.description:
Whether push is configured on this server, the public VAPID key the browser
subscribes with, how many devices are subscribed, every notification type
with the user's effective setting (registry default unless they changed it),
and quiet hours. `available` is false for corporation types when none of the
user's characters is in a corporation.

put.description:
A partial change: only the listed types and fields are updated. `lead_minutes`
must be one of the type's `lead_options`; `character_ids` (empty means all)
must be the user's own characters and only applies to types that support it.
Send `quiet_hours` with null start/end to clear it.

Stores the browser's push subscription (`PushSubscription.toJSON()`); the same
endpoint is updated rather than duplicated.

post.description:
Delivers a sample message to every subscribed device. `sent` is how many
devices accepted it; subscriptions the push service reports as gone are removed.

examples: Push notifications are not configured on this server.

get.description:
Colonies of every character with extractors, factories, storage fill,
combined output per hour, alerts and a factory capacity check. Read
from a cache that is filled from ESI on first use (a cold cache can be
slow); no prices are involved, so there is no `meta.freshness`.

post.description: The next dashboard request reads ESI again.

get.description:
The corporation's projects, most recently modified first, with progress,
reward and contributors. Needs a main character in a corporation with
the esi-corporations.read_projects.v1 scope; otherwise 403.
`meta.summary` holds totals across all projects.

ISK contribution rankings over the corporation's rewarded projects that
are Closed or Completed, largest first. Each contributor's ISK is the
units contributed times the project's reward per unit. Same 403 as
`GET /corporation/projects`.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Only projects modified on or after this day (Y-m-d).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Only projects modified on or before this day (Y-m-d).

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive part of the project name.

post.description:
Forgets the cached projects and contributors of the corporation, so the
next read asks ESI again. Returns 204.

get.description:
Published reaction formulas whose name contains `q`, by name, at most
20 (not paginated). Serves both the reactions calculator and the
reaction planner.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match on the name).

get.description: Input materials, products and base time for one reaction run.
Sorted by name.

post.description:
Omitted settings fall back to defaults (240 runs per slot, athanor, no
rigs, lowsec, 0 tax).

put.summary: Update a reaction plan. Partial: only the fields sent change

post.description:
Resolves each composite's chain into composite and intermediate slots
and raw materials, then prices it: input cost, output value, job fee,
facility tax, SCC fee, profit and margin. Unknown formulas are
skipped.

Summed over your characters with the assets scope; one row per
requested type id (0 when none is owned).
post.summary: Owned quantity of each requested type

post.description:
One row per requested formula type id (type_id, quantity), counting
formulas in your characters' blueprints and in active reaction jobs.
When none of your characters has the blueprints scope,
has_blueprint_scope is false and formulas is empty.

Materials with the rig bonus, reaction time, and cost/profit after
the SCC fee. Materials, base time and portion size come from the SDE
when not posted. A formula with no materials is a 422 on
formula_type_id.

get.description: 404 when the character is not one of yours.
get.summary: Reaction skills of one of your characters

get.description:
Every published tech I blueprint with the best ME/TE the user owns and
which characters hold it. Ownership needs the blueprint scope;
`meta.has_blueprint_data` is false when no character has it, and
`meta.characters_without_scope` lists those that lack it. Paginated
(the CSV export at `/industry/blueprint-research/export` takes the
same filters and returns every row).

parameters.name: market_group
parameters.description: Only blueprints whose product is in this market group.

get.description:
Every published reaction formula with how many the user owns (in
hangars and locked in running reaction jobs) and which characters hold
them. Not paginated: there are fewer than a hundred. The CSV export is
at `/industry/reaction-formula-research/export`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Reaction group id: 1888 composite, 1889 biochemical, 4097 hybrid.

post.description:
Ends the web session shared with the SPA: logs out, invalidates the
session and rotates the CSRF token. Returns 204 with no body.

get.description:
Systems whose name contains `q` (case-insensitive substring), by name,
at most 20 (not paginated). SDE only; security is unrounded.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match on the name).

get.description:
ESI cost index per industry activity for the system (ESI data cached up
to 6 h); 0 for activities ESI does not list. 404 when the system is
neither in the SDE nor in ESI's list; 503 when ESI is unavailable.

examples: Cost indices are unavailable from ESI right now.

get.summary: List sponsors, in display order (not paginated)

post.summary: Add a sponsor with its banner (multipart form)
Change a sponsor (multipart form, sent with POST). A new banner replaces the old one

delete.summary: Delete a sponsor and its banner

get.description:
Stations whose name contains `q`, by name, at most 20 (not paginated),
optionally only in `solar_system_id`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match on the name).

parameters.name: solar_system_id
parameters.description: Only stations in this solar system.

get.description:
Every NPC station in the system, by name, paginated; `q` (2+ characters)
narrows by name. 404 when the system is not in the SDE.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Narrow to station names containing this text (ignored under 2 characters).

get.description: Default first, then by name.

post.description: With `is_default` true it becomes the only default.

put.summary: Update a station config. Partial: only the fields sent change

post.description: Clears the flag on the user's other configs for the same activity.
post.summary: Make a station config the default

post.description: The item name is taken from the type. Returns 201 with the item.
post.summary: Track a type, or change the wanted quantity if you already track it

put.description: 404 for an unknown item or one that is not yours.
put.summary: Change the wanted quantity of a stock item

delete.description: 404 for an unknown item or one that is not yours.

get.description:
The user's watched items by name, each with the wanted quantity, what
the corporation hangars hold and the shortfall. `meta.warning` says why
on-hand quantities are all 0 when corporation assets cannot be read.

post.description: Forgets the cached assets so the next report reads them again.

get.description:
Published types whose name contains `q`, by name, at most
`meta.limit` (20) results. Only for users with the Industry Stock
Manager enabled; otherwise 403.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of a published type name.

get.description:
The user's own station and structure configs for the calculators,
defaults first then by name, optionally for one activity.

parameters.name: activity_type
parameters.description: Only structures set up for this activity.

post.description:
With `is_default` it becomes the default for its activity type and your
other structures of that type lose the flag. Returns 201.

put.summary: Change a structure; only the fields sent are changed

post.description: Your other structures of that activity type lose the flag.
post.summary: Make a structure the default for its activity type

get.description: The corporation's windows by system, structure type and name.

Buy-order / sell-order spreads in one trade hub region, after broker
fees and sales tax, sorted by estimated daily ISK profit. The full
result is paginated (the old route capped it with `limit` instead).

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Trade hub region. Default 10000002 (The Forge / Jita).

get.description:
Buy from sell orders in one trade hub and sell into buy orders in
another, after sales tax and optional hauling cost per m3. Sorted by
estimated daily ISK profit and paginated.

`meta.freshness` describes the buy (source) region; `meta.freshness_by_region`
has the same block for both regions, keyed by region id.

parameters.name: buy_region_id
parameters.description: Region to buy in (source). Default 10000002 (The Forge / Jita).

parameters.name: sell_region_id
parameters.description: Region to sell in (destination). Default 10000043 (Domain / Amarr). Must differ from buy_region_id.

get.description:
Published types that have a market group and whose name contains `q`,
by name, at most 50 (not paginated). `exclude_meta_groups[]` leaves out
meta groups (1 Tech I, 2 Tech II, 4 Faction, ...).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive substring match on the name).

get.description: One inventory type from the SDE, or from ESI when the SDE has no row.

Searchable by account name, email or character name, sortable, 20 a
page by default. Admins only.

parameters.name: search
